entries.label: class_g_08_math_01
entries.text: The time has come to test how well you all have\nlearned in my class![VAR 0x0114(0029)]

entries.label: class_g_08_math_02
entries.text: Let’s begin before the information simmering in\nyour brains from a last-minute cram session fades.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

entries.label: class_g_08_question_01
entries.text:
1. Which of the following Meal Powers makes it
    easier to come across Shiny Pokémon?

A) Sparkling Power
B) Encounter Power
C) Catching Power

entries.label: class_g_08_ansewer_01a
entries.text: A) Sparkling Power

entries.label: class_g_08_ansewer_01b
entries.text: B) Encounter Power

entries.label: class_g_08_ansewer_01c
entries.text: C) Catching Power

entries.label: class_g_08_question_02
entries.text:
2. Which of the following is NOT an effect of
    Egg Power?

A) It makes Eggs hatch faster
B) It helps hatch strong Pokémon
C) It makes Eggs easier to find

entries.label: class_g_08_ansewer_02a
entries.text: A) It makes Eggs hatch faster

entries.label: class_g_08_ansewer_02b
entries.text: B) It helps hatch strong Pokémon

entries.label: class_g_08_ansewer_02c
entries.text: C) It makes Eggs easier to find

entries.label: class_g_08_question_03
entries.text:
3. What is a simple yet important tactic for
    increasing the effectiveness of Meal Powers?

A) Make food more often
B) Make food at home
C) Make food with others

entries.label: class_g_08_ansewer_03a
entries.text: A) Make food more often

entries.label: class_g_08_ansewer_03b
entries.text: B) Make food at home

entries.label: class_g_08_ansewer_03c
entries.text: C) Make food with others

entries.label: class_g_08_question_04
entries.text:
4. What is the correct action to take when your
    adorable Pokémon become dirty?

A) Pokémon Wash
B) Pokémon Dash
C) Pokémon Wish

entries.label: class_g_08_ansewer_04a
entries.text: A) Pokémon Wash

entries.label: class_g_08_ansewer_04b
entries.text: B) Pokémon Dash

entries.label: class_g_08_ansewer_04c
entries.text: C) Pokémon Wish

entries.label: class_g_08_question_05
entries.text:
5. This is a question about academy rules. Should
    you change your uniform tops and bottoms to
    properly match each season?

A) Yes, you should
B) It doesn’t matter

entries.label: class_g_08_ansewer_05a
entries.text: A) Yes, you should

entries.label: class_g_08_ansewer_05b
entries.text: B) It doesn’t matter

entries.label: class_g_08_math_03
entries.text: The time for answering questions has come to an\nend. Please stop writing.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

entries.label: class_g_08_math_04
entries.text: I...made the questions a little easier than I’d\nplanned to, as a way of saying thank you for\r\ninforming me about Rotom Phone cases.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

entries.label: class_g_08_math_05
entries.text: I trust that you all gave this exam everything you\nhad so that you will not have to retake it.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

entries.label: class_g_08_math_06
entries.text: Please remember to ask for your scores at the\nfront desk before leaving for the day.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
